text:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx error rate detected for account `apollo-corp` on Dedicated-EU-1 (routing-proxy-eu). Errors > 25% across user-facing endpoints. Auto-paging @pagerduty-oncall. Link: https://internal.incidents/runbooks/routing-proxy

Evan M: I’m on call — ACK. Setting severity to Sev2. Gathering logs and recent deploy history.

Priya S: Thanks Evan. Can you confirm last deploy id for routing-proxy-eu and whether autoscaler changed config in the last hour? Also check if global fallback routing is healthy so we can fail traffic to Hosted if needed.

Evan M: Deploy id `deploy-2026-03-28-77` rolled at 10:12 UTC. Autoscaler logged several scale-down/scale-up cycles starting 10:15 UTC. Suspect thrash after config tweak.

Evan M: Starting mitigation: rolling back routing-proxy-eu on Dedicated-EU-1 to `deploy-2026-03-27-12`. Command: ```reliantctl deploy rollback --cluster dedicated-eu-1 --service routing-proxy --to deploy-2026-03-27-12```

Incident Bot: STATUS PAGE DRAFT (please copy/edit before publishing):
```
Status: Partial outage affecting inference traffic for a subset of enterprise customers (Apollo).
Scope: Dedicated-EU-1 routing proxy experiencing 5xx responses causing degraded request success rates.
Impact: Customers may see elevated latencies and intermittent 5xx errors for requests routed to Dedicated-EU-1.
Current Action: Rolling back recent routing-proxy rollout and enabling temporary fallback to Hosted API for affected accounts.
ETA: Mitigation in progress. Next update in 10 minutes.
```

Marta K: CS contact list for Apollo (per contract):
- Sasha Ivanov (Apollo SRE) — sasha@apollo.com, +1-555-0199 (primary pager)
- Luca Moreno (Prod Eng) — luca@apollo.com, +1-555-0147
- Priyanka Shah (Customer Success RMM) — priya.shah@apollo.com (account lead)
Routing: Page Sasha first; escalate to Priyanka if no ack in 10m; escalate to CTO (terry@apollo.com) after 25m if unresolved.

Marta K: Draft tailored customer-facing blurb (for CS to send):
"We’re currently investigating elevated errors affecting Apollo traffic routed to our Dedicated EU cluster. Our engineers have identified the likely cause and are rolling back a recent routing change; we’ve enabled a temporary fallback to our hosted endpoint to limit impact. You may experience intermittent 5xx errors for requests that hit Dedicated-EU-1. We will follow up with another update in 10 minutes and a post-incident summary once resolved. Contact Sasha or your CSM for urgent questions"

Raj P: I’m pulling autoscaler and proxy logs now. Noticed `scale_down` events followed by `scale_up` in <1m windows — likely causing stale cache/connection storms. Rollback should stabilize. Also flagging model-serving KV cache invalidations for further postmortem. Link to logs: internal-logs/routing-proxy/eu (copied into ticket).

Clara H: Planning handoff: Evan you good to hand off monitoring/updates to Tom in ~15 minutes? Who will publish status page?

Evan M: I’ll keep monitoring until error rates drop below baseline (~<5%). If stable in 10m, I’ll publish the initial status page update and hand off to Tom for continued monitoring and customer comm cadence.

Tom L: I’ll take the handoff at +15m. I’ll update the status page every 10 minutes and send the next customer-facing note if we see continued improvement or if rollback completes.

Incident Bot: Automated note: rollback job `rb-3965432100-1` started at 10:28 UTC.

Evan M: Rollback finished at 10:33 UTC. Observed 5xx rate dropping from 28% -> 2% over 3 minutes. Enabling temporary Hosted fallback for apollo-corp (throttle to 5qps) while we verify.

Marta K: Sending Sasha a short proactive ping now with the drafted blurb and direct line for updates.

Tom L: Verified metrics: p50 latency stable, 5xxs at 1.8% over last 5m and trending down. Removing fallback routing in 10m if stable. Next public update queued.

Evan M: Post-mitigation action items:
- Full autoscaler config audit for Dedicated-EU-1 (Raj)
- Postmortem to include rollout gating improvements + health checks (Priya)
- CS follow-up email and post-incident summary to Apollo (Marta)

Tom L: Handoff accepted. I will continue updates and close the incident once baseline sustained for 30m.

Incident Bot: Incident transitioned to MONITORING. Last update: rollback successful, mitigation validated.
